name: Claude Code with containers inside
description: Like claude, plus rootless podman and the sandbox command inside, so the agent can build images, run containers and make sandboxes of its own, and Python 3 with uv. Weakens the sandbox: /dev/net/tun, /proc unmasked and a seccomp profile allowing sethostname/setdomainname (see the README). Use claude unless the agent needs containers

trustWorkspace.description: 1: Claude Code trusts the workspace folder from the start (no "Do you trust this folder?" question; the sandbox contains what it runs). 0: it asks, as outside a sandbox
